market.question: Will the BLS Employment Situation for Nov 2026 (Dec 4) report a first-print NFP change of +90,000 or more?
market.resolution_criteria:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes, +90,000 or more": Wins if the BLS Employment Situation news release for November 2026, published strictly after 2026-11-24T09:10:01.801Z and at or before 2026-12-04T20:30:00.000Z, reports a first-print total nonfarm payroll (NFP) change of +90,000 or greater.
- "No, below +90,000": Wins if the BLS Employment Situation news release for November 2026, published strictly after 2026-11-24T09:10:01.801Z and at or before 2026-12-04T20:30:00.000Z, reports a first-print total nonfarm payroll (NFP) change of less than +90,000 (including any negative or zero figure).

Clarifications:
- The NFP figure used is the total nonfarm payroll employment change as stated in the initial ("first-print") release of the November 2026 Employment Situation report; subsequent revisions to this figure are not considered.
